meta.title: Middle Corridor Freight Monitor
meta.methodology_note: MCFI Fundamental Cost v1.0: market freight is compared with a transparent modelled structural cost for one loaded SOC 40HC from Xi'an to Absheron/Alat. No calendar month is used as the index base.
meta.data_warning: Historical coverage reflects the availability of published market assessments.

model.name: MCFI-40 Fundamental
model.description: A structural freight-cost index comparing observed Xi'an–Absheron/Alat 40HC market freight with a transparent theoretical route cost.

shipment.ownership: Market assessment; container ownership basis recorded where available
shipment.core_path: Xi’an International Port → Horgos/Khorgos (China) → Altynkol / Khorgos Gateway (Kazakhstan) → Aktau Port → Port of Baku (Alat) → Absheron/Baku area
shipment.pricing_basis: USD per 40HC, terminal-to-terminal market assessment; inclusions recorded source-by-source

model.formula: MCFI = observed market freight ÷ modelled fundamental route cost × 100.
model.route_quote_rule: For each route/month, use the midpoint of the comparable market range; if multiple same-grade market assessments exist, use the median of their midpoints.
source_hierarchy: Published carrier and forwarder tariffs for additional market reference
model.publication_rule: Publish MCFI when a comparable Xi'an–Absheron/Alat 40HC market assessment is available and all fundamental-cost blocks have an auditable source or explicitly identified modelling rule.
model.methodological_anchor: Argus introduced monthly 40HC assessments for Xi’an–Absheron/Baku and Xi’an–Mersin/Ambarli in April 2026; the same two-lane structure is used retrospectively when equivalent historical market ranges are recoverable.
model.reference_note: 100 means observed market freight equals the modelled fundamental cost. Values above 100 indicate a market premium; values below 100 indicate market freight below the modelled structural cost.

theoretical_cost_model.route: Xi’an International Port → Horgos/Khorgos (China) → Altynkol / Khorgos Gateway (Kazakhstan) → Aktau Port → Port of Baku (Alat) → Absheron/Baku area

components.note: Route aligned with the Xi'an–Baku/Poti Middle Corridor service via Horgos/Khorgos. The tariff formula is a structural modelling rule, not an executable 2026 quote.

components.note: Latest public official all-in structural anchor located. It is not represented as a current executable October 2026 quotation.

theoretical_cost_model.confidence_note: China linehaul/border items are modelled from public tariff rules and a documented 3,200 km Xi'an–Horgos rail distance; the central TITR block uses published official anchors. From April 2026 the last KTZ Express public rate is carried forward until a newer public all-in rate is located.
